title: A new home
instr: For each question, write the correct answer. Write ONE word for each gap.
paras: Hi Sam, I'm sorry I didn't write (1) ___ you last week. We were very busy because we moved to a new flat on Saturday.
The flat is on the sixth floor, so there's a great view (2) ___ the city. It's bigger (3) ___ our old flat, and I've got my own bedroom now!

There's a park near here, and I go running there every morning. (4) ___ you like to come and stay next month? You can sleep in my room and I'll sleep on the sofa. Let me know (5) ___ you can come. My mum says you are welcome any time. See you (6) ___, Ben

ev.s: I'm sorry I didn't write (1) ___ you last week.

items.why: "write to somebody" = viết thư cho ai.

ev.s: there's a great view (2) ___ the city

items.why: "a view of / over + nơi" = tầm nhìn ra đâu.

ev.s: It's bigger (3) ___ our old flat

items.why: So sánh hơn: bigger than.

ev.s: (4) ___ you like to come and stay next month?

items.why: Lời mời lịch sự: Would you like to…?

ev.s: Let me know (5) ___ you can come.

items.why: "Let me know if / when you can come" = báo mình biết bạn có đến được không / khi nào đến được.

ev.s: See you (6) ___, Ben

items.why: Câu kết thư quen thuộc: See you soon.

title: Party invitation
instr: For each question, write the correct answer. Write ONE word for each gap.
paras: Hi everyone! It's my birthday next Saturday, and I'm having a party (1) ___ my house. It starts at seven o'clock and finishes at about eleven.
My parents (2) ___ going to cook some Vietnamese food, so please don't eat dinner before you come! There will (3) ___ music and games in the garden.

Please don't buy me a present. I'd prefer you to bring (4) ___ CD or a book that you have already read, and we can swap them. If you need help finding the house, call me (5) ___ text me. Please tell me by Wednesday if you (6) ___ come. Mai

ev.s: I'm having a party (1) ___ my house

items.why: "at / in my house" = ở nhà mình.

ev.s: My parents (2) ___ going to cook some Vietnamese food

items.why: "be going to": chủ ngữ số nhiều "My parents" → are.

ev.s: There will (3) ___ music and games in the garden.

items.why: "There will be" = sẽ có.

ev.s: I'd prefer you to bring (4) ___ CD or a book

items.why: Danh từ đếm được số ít: a CD (hoặc one / any / your CD).

ev.s: call me (5) ___ text me

items.why: "call me or text me" = gọi hoặc nhắn tin.

ev.s: Please tell me by Wednesday if you (6) ___ come.

items.why: "if you can / can't come" = bạn có đến được hay không.

title: My weekend
instr: For each question, write the correct answer. Write ONE word for each gap.
paras: Last weekend was really busy. On Saturday morning, I played football (1) ___ my brother and his friends. We lost, but it was fun.
In the afternoon, I went to the shopping centre because I needed (2) ___ new pair of shoes. I looked in five shops, but I didn't find (3) ___ I liked. In the end I bought a T-shirt instead.

On Sunday, it rained all day, (4) ___ I stayed at home. I watched two films and did my homework. My sister made a cake, and we ate it while we were watching the second film. It was (5) ___ best cake I've ever had! Next weekend I'm going to visit my cousins, (6) ___ live in Hai Phong.

ev.s: I played football (1) ___ my brother and his friends

items.why: "play football with / against somebody" = chơi cùng / chơi với đội của ai.

ev.s: I needed (2) ___ new pair of shoes

items.why: "a new pair of shoes" = một đôi giày mới.

ev.s: I didn't find (3) ___ I liked

items.why: Câu phủ định: didn't find anything / any (that) I liked.

ev.s: it rained all day, (4) ___ I stayed at home

items.why: "so" nối kết quả: trời mưa nên ở nhà.

ev.s: It was (5) ___ best cake I've ever had!

items.why: So sánh nhất: the best.

ev.s: my cousins, (6) ___ live in Hai Phong

items.why: Đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: my cousins, who live in Hai Phong.

title: Asking about a course
instr: For each question, write the correct answer. Write ONE word for each gap.
paras: Dear Sir or Madam, I saw your advert for a cooking course (1) ___ the internet, and I would like some more information.
First, (2) ___ much does the course cost? I am a student, so I hope there is a cheaper price for students. Also, I work (3) ___ Monday to Friday, so can I join the Saturday class?
I have (4) ___ cooked Japanese food before, so I am a beginner. Do I need (5) ___ bring my own knives? I look forward to hearing (6) ___ you. Yours faithfully, Tran Van Nam

ev.s: I saw your advert for a cooking course (1) ___ the internet

items.why: "on the internet" = trên mạng.

ev.s: (2) ___ much does the course cost?

items.why: "How much…?" hỏi giá.

ev.s: I work (3) ___ Monday to Friday

items.why: "from Monday to Friday" = từ thứ Hai đến thứ Sáu.

ev.s: I have (4) ___ cooked Japanese food before, so I am a beginner.

items.why: "I have never / not cooked" = chưa từng nấu; vì vậy mới là người mới bắt đầu.

ev.s: Do I need (5) ___ bring my own knives?

items.why: "need to + động từ".

ev.s: I look forward to hearing (6) ___ you.

items.why: "look forward to hearing from you" = mong nhận được hồi âm.

title: The lost dog
instr: For each question, write the correct answer. Write ONE word for each gap.
paras: Last Tuesday, my dog Lucky ran away (1) ___ we were walking in the park. A man was flying a big kite, and Lucky was scared of it.

I looked for him everywhere, but I couldn't find him. I was so worried that I couldn't sleep (2) ___ night. The next morning, my dad and I made some posters with Lucky's photo and put (3) ___ up in the streets near our house.

In the afternoon, a woman phoned us. She said that Lucky was in her garden, eating (4) ___ cat's food! When we arrived, Lucky ran to me and jumped up. I was (5) ___ happy that I started to cry. Now I always keep him on a lead when there (6) ___ kites in the sky.

ev.s: my dog Lucky ran away (1) ___ we were walking in the park

items.why: "while / when we were walking" = trong lúc đang đi dạo.

ev.s: I couldn't sleep (2) ___ night

items.why: "that night" / "all night" = đêm đó / cả đêm.

ev.s: put (3) ___ up in the streets near our house

items.why: Đại từ thay cho "some posters".

ev.s: eating (4) ___ cat's food

items.why: "her / the / its cat's food" = thức ăn của con mèo (nhà bà ấy).

ev.s: I was (5) ___ happy that I started to cry.

items.why: "so + tính từ + that" = quá… đến nỗi.

ev.s: when there (6) ___ kites in the sky

items.why: "there are + danh từ số nhiều" (kites).
